scope: Computational artificial-life research: integer programs on a bounded virtual machine, search operators and simulated populations of software objects. No biological material, organism, procedure or design of any kind.
design: paired: 2000 one-operator mutants per genome under grammar B and under v0.4, 1 held-out set, A' (xor 1) and A (xor 15)
material_rule: material if the grammars differ in hit share, or in beneficial share by > 2x with >= 10 beneficial mutants pooled
